note: Five-year series is only in the Financial Highlights table (p.6). MD&A p.32 gives 2025 vs 2024 only (0.23x vs 0.29x net, 0.62x vs 0.65x gross), so it is not listed.

question: Berapa core profit Indofood tahun 2025, dan apa bedanya dengan laba bersih yang dilaporkan?
reference: Core profit (tanpa pos non-recurring dan selisih kurs) naik 1% menjadi Rp11,39 triliun dari Rp11,34 triliun di 2024. Laba tahun berjalan yang diatribusikan kepada pemilik entitas induk (dilaporkan) naik 24% menjadi Rp10,68 triliun dari Rp8,64 triliun; laba tahun berjalan konsolidasian Rp15,56 triliun (+19%). Kenaikan laba dilaporkan didorong kinerja operasional, turunnya rugi kurs belum terealisasi dari aktivitas pendanaan, dan basis 2024 yang memuat goodwill impairment investasi di Nigeria.
note: p.27 (President Director's report) says core profit grew 1% but gives no amount, so it is not listed.

question: Segmen usaha INDF mana yang menyumbang laba usaha terbesar pada 2025, dan berapa laba usaha tiap segmen?
reference: Laba usaha segmen 2025 (Rp juta, Catatan 36 laporan keuangan konsolidasian): Produk Konsumen Bermerek (CBP) 15.756.654; Bogasari (termasuk kantor pusat) 2.831.688; Agribisnis 4.127.765; Distribusi 627.289; eliminasi 12.627; total laba usaha segmen 23.356.023. Ditambah penghasilan operasi lain yang tidak dialokasikan 1.213.114, laba usaha (EBIT) konsolidasian 24.569.137. CBP terbesar (sekitar dua pertiga laba usaha segmen). Penjualan neto segmen: CBP 75.743.171; Bogasari 31.108.303; Agribisnis 21.036.857; Distribusi 7.425.311.

question: How has MAP's (MAPI) gross profit margin moved from 2023 to 2025?
reference: Consolidated gross profit margin: 45.3% (2023), 42.7% (2024), 41.7% (2025), so it narrowed each year. Gross profit was Rp17,954 billion in 2025 on net revenues of Rp43,083 billion. Operating profit margin was 10.8%, 9.1% and 9.3%; net income margin 7.0%, 5.7% and 6.3%.
note: Financial Highlights table on spread p.23 (printed pp.44-45). Text extraction mixes the columns, so the regex matches the 2025 column (41.7% 9.3%). MD&A p.42 gives gross profit amounts (+11.2% to Rp18.0T) but no margin %.

question: Segmen apa yang menjadi penyumbang pendapatan terbesar MAPI pada 2025 dan berapa kontribusinya?
reference: Specialty retail (penjualan ritel) memberikan 85,5% pendapatan bersih, sekitar Rp36,8 triliun (Rp36.845.918 juta di catatan segmen). Pendapatan bersih konsolidasian Rp43,1 triliun (Rp43.083.208 juta), naik 13,9%. Segmen lain menurut MD&A: food & beverage 7,5% (Rp3,2 triliun), department store 6,4% (Rp2,7 triliun), others 0,6% (Rp259 miliar).
note: p.41 gives shares only; p.42 gives shares and amounts; p.214 (FS segment note) gives amounts. The question asks only about the largest segment to avoid this.

question: How many stores did MAPI operate at the end of 2025, and how many of them were in Indonesia?
reference: 4,023 stores at end-2025, after a net addition of 320 stores (616 gross store openings per p.43). Indonesia had 3,543 stores; the other 480 were overseas: Philippines 261, Malaysia 85, Thailand 55, Vietnam 40, Singapore 27, Cambodia 12.
note: Total on p.27 (Board letter, with net +320) and p.30 (Company in Brief); the country split is only on p.32 (Operating Area), where it sums to 4,023. p.7 and p.19 just say '4,000+'.

question: How has Telkomsel's share of Indonesia's mobile subscriber market changed from 2023 to 2025?
reference: Telkomsel's mobile subscriber market share was 50.5% in 2023, 50.9% in 2024 and 48.4% in 2025; competitors held 49.5%, 49.1% and 51.6%. The 2025 drop follows the completion of the XL Axiata-Smartfren merger into XLSmart in April 2025. The text gives the 2025 structure: Telkomsel above 48%, IOH 29%, XLSmart almost 23%. Subscribers were 156.1 million at end-2025 (-2.1% YoY).
evidence: Market Share Pelanggan Seluler Telkomsel dan Kompetitor

question: Apa target TLKM untuk 2026 terkait belanja modal dan rasio utang terhadap EBITDA?
reference: Tabel target 2026: belanja modal sekitar 15%-20% dari pendapatan, fokus pada infrastruktur bisnis di domain core dan next core; rasio utang terhadap EBITDA dijaga di kisaran 0,9x. question: How did Unilever Indonesia's two segments, Home & Personal Care and Foods & Refreshment, perform in 2025 in terms of net sales and gross margin?
reference: Continuing operations (excl. Ice Cream and Tea), Rp million: Home & Personal Care net sales 23,359,149 (2024: 22,426,415; +4.2%), gross margin 47.7% (2024: 49.7%), 73.1% of sales; Foods & Refreshment net sales 8,584,312 (2024: 8,196,199; +4.7%), gross margin 44.8% (2024: 41.7%), 26.9% of sales. Total net sales Rp31,943,461 million, gross margin 46.9% (2024: 47.5%).
note: Segment table on p.209 (MD&A) gives margins directly; p.436 (segment note) gives 2025 segment net sales and gross profit (margin computable). p.209 narrative rounds to Rp23.4T / Rp8.6T and 73%/27%.

question: Laba Unilever Indonesia tahun 2025 melonjak jadi sekitar Rp7,6 triliun. Berapa yang berasal dari operasi yang dilanjutkan dan berapa dari penjualan bisnis yang dihentikan?
reference: Laba tahun berjalan 2025 Rp7.641 miliar (2024: Rp3.369 miliar), terdiri dari laba operasi yang dilanjutkan Rp3.537 miliar (naik 21,8% dari Rp2.905 miliar), laba tahun berjalan operasi yang dihentikan (es krim & teh) Rp309 miliar (turun 33,3%), dan laba penjualan operasi yang dihentikan (divestasi bisnis Es Krim, selesai 8 Desember 2025) Rp3.794 miliar setelah pajak.
note: Table on p.14 (Rp miliar) and p.208 (Rp juta), narrative on p.211, income statement p.366. p.12 and p.209 show 'net profit' 3.5T (continuing) and 7,641,161 total, respectively, so the question explicitly asks for the split. Gross gain before tax was Rp4,811.9bn (p.451).

question: How has Surge (WIFI)'s revenue mix between digital infrastructure and advertising shifted from 2023 to 2025?
